tasks.label: 01 First Run: Create Configuration
tasks.detail: Run once. An existing marketsieve.toml is never overwritten.

tasks.label: 02 First Run: Import Portfolio CSV
tasks.detail: Import the canonical holdings CSV. Import time is used as as-of; the source file is not retained.

tasks.label: 03 First Run: Check Readiness
tasks.detail: Check configuration, portfolio, credentials, and the next operation.

tasks.label: 10 Daily: Analyze JP Close and Prepare ChatGPT Request (Network)
tasks.detail: Run after the Japanese market closes. The terminal prints the upload file and next action.

tasks.label: 20 Daily: Analyze US Close and Prepare ChatGPT Request (Network)
tasks.detail: Run after the U.S. market closes. The terminal prints the upload file and next action.

tasks.label: 30 Weekly: Build Brief and Prepare ChatGPT Request (After JP and US)
tasks.detail: Run on the weekend after both daily reports. This operation is offline.

tasks.label: 40 ChatGPT: Import Saved Response and Show Explanation
tasks.detail: Run after saving the ChatGPT JSON response. Only a validated explanation is shown.

tasks.label: Advanced: Prepare ChatGPT Request from Latest Report
Advanced: Show Latest AI Explanation Only
